rationale: Record a source-compatible performance optimization in the Pulp-owned materialized runtime canonicalizer. Repeated inline JSX/Babel programs within one imported document now share the same deterministic esbuild result, while each script remains emitted, vendor removal remains unchanged, and the canonicalized document contract is preserved. The cache is scoped to one document pass and does not change source authority, DesignIR, capture evidence, rendering, or Vellum ownership.
